central_situation: Neet tries to tunnel backwards in time to attend an India wedding already completed; practical obstacles expose his wish to belong.
intended_feeling: Affectionate ridiculous determination becomes a genuine family ceremony.

wants.Neet: Attend as Best Man and have his speech heard.

preserved: Full reconstructed speech and emotional admission

changes.before: Around his neck: a coil of orange extension cord (“industrial lifeline”).
changes.after: Beside him: a coil of orange extension cord (“industrial lifeline”).

They dug.

Neet’s first scoop stayed inside the glove. He shook it. The dirt landed in his other glove.

Buddy waited.

“Topsoil transfer,” Neet said. “Successful.”

changes.before: Buddy sighed. “Fine. But I reserve the right to say ‘told you so’ when the lawn bites back.”
changes.after:
Buddy looked at the two tennis balls. He had brought one outside yesterday. Apparently it was geology now.

“Fine. But I reserve the right to say ‘told you so’ when the lawn bites back.” He nudged both samples behind his feet. Whatever happened to India, they were coming home.

changes.before: “At ease, Consultant Wriggle,” Neet said, relocating the worm with military courtesy.
changes.after:
“At ease, Consultant Wriggle,” Neet said, relocating the worm with military courtesy.

Buddy watched the worm disappear under a leaf. “First member of the expedition to arrive somewhere.”

They did not.

Neet waited for a gap in the barking, opened his mouth, and lost the gap. Buddy quietly moved the tennis balls another foot from the excavation.

changes.before: Heather followed with her “I will listen first and laugh second” smile. She surveyed the scene: colander helmet, dirt baby pool, worm witness, and a dog vibrating with divine purpose.
changes.after:
Heather followed with her “I will listen first and laugh second” smile. She surveyed the scene: colander helmet, dirt baby pool, worm witness, and a dog vibrating with divine purpose.

“Found the colander,” she said.

Sagar looked into the hole. “And the spoon.”

Neither sounded as relieved as Neet felt they should.

changes.after:
Buddy fetched the blanket, walking backward so he could keep an eye on the balls. He backed gently into the planter box.

Neet steadied it with a gloved paw.

“Venue inspection,” Buddy said.

“Successful,” said Neet.

In five minutes, the backyard transformed:

changes.before: Buddy kept both tennis-ball core samples out of the fill.
changes.after:
Buddy kept both tennis-ball core samples out of the fill. Each time a shovel approached, he picked one up, remembered the other, and put the first down to check it. Heather finally placed them together on the deck.

“Your delegation is safe,” she told him.

He counted them anyway.
